name: smwmusic-nsync-no-more-foolishness-bye-bye-bye-remix
title: NSYNC - No More Foolishness! ~ Bye Bye Bye (Remix)
description:
❝ Don't really want to make it tough
I just want to tell you that I've had enough
It might sound crazy but it ain't no lie
Baby bye bye bye ❞
ㅤ- N'SYNC, 2000

Did an arrangement of Bye Bye Bye by N'SYNC. Watched Deadpool & Wolverine (god-tier movie coming from a very biased Deadpool fan) a couple months back and was sent back by two decades the second I heard that song pop up at the beginning (I was singing throughout the entire sequence) and also once more grinding the Ch. 5 Season 4 Fortnite Battle Pass recently and obtaining the Deadpool & Wolverine Bundle + the Bye Bye Bye taunt. Really wanted to arrange this song after all of that 'cuz I haven't done a non-VGM track in a hot minute, and N'SYNC was a huge part of my childhood (quite literally some of the first ever music I heard).

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's text file:
ㅤ1. G# Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. G# Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. A Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ4. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Drastically Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
